about: The second independent derivation of the keys for corpus 3's 31 new tasks.

assumptions.text: Lists representing sets are sorted by identifier or group value. List permutations and optional unscored explanation text are representation choices, not semantic variants.

Assigned-crew membership is tested solely in assignedCrewIds; the commander and participants do not supply membership. No qualifying mission also has this person as commander, so excluding such missions would not alter the result.

An existing release with no qualifying mapped references yields ANSWERED and an empty mission list, since the question defines membership by that release. Missing mappings are not inferred from other releases.

B16.basis: PRS-2727; Personnel positionTitle, mapping 1.3 crew entries, and Missions commander/assigned crew union; commander role takes precedence.

B17.basis: PRS-1100; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedCrewIds only, then mission type.

B18.basis: PRS-1053; reverse mapping 1.3 into commandingOfficerId only.

B19.basis: PRS-1058; reverse mapping 1.3 into commander or assigned crew, then mission status.

B20.basis: All 1000 Personnel records filtered by ON_LEAVE; reverse mapping 1.3 into commander/assigned crew, retaining nonempty mission sets.

B21.basis: Personnel Section Supervisor IDs PRS-2002, PRS-2019, PRS-2167, PRS-2383, PRS-2522, PRS-2608, PRS-2728; mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew intersection.

B22.basis: Personnel COMMAND department; mapping 1.3 commandingOfficerId targets only.

B23.basis: Direct supervisorPersonnelId=PRS-1053 in Personnel, excluding the supervisor; mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew intersection.

B24.basis: Assets name resolves to AST-0007; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

B25.basis: Assets kind SHUTTLE; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

B26.basis: Assets direct parentAssetId AST-0029; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

B27.basis: Assets current status MISSING; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

B28.basis: Both AST-0005 and AST-0007 in the mapping 1.3 targets of mission assignedAssetIds.

B29.basis: Assets direct parentAssetId AST-0023; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

B30.basis: ST-00000LD4T; mapping 1.3 commander to Personnel department and assigned assets to Assets kind.

B31.basis: All RESCUE missions; mapping 1.3 commander joined to Personnel (absent department is null), assigned assets joined to held Assets records.

C13.basis: PRS-0714; title resolved in Personnel; only mapping 1.1 crew entries qualify commander/assigned references. An empty match is an answered empty set.

C14.basis: PRS-1101; title resolved in Personnel; only mapping 1.1 crew entries qualify commander/assigned references. An empty match is an answered empty set.

C15.basis: Assets kind ROVER; reverse mapping 1.3 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

C16.basis: Assets identifier AST-0024; reverse mapping 1.0 into assignedAssetIds. Only held Assets targets count; no matching reference gives an answered empty set.

E17.basis: Every Assets SHUTTLE, including unused ones; distinct mission count after mapping 1.3 assigned assets.

E18.basis: Mapping 1.3 assigned assets joined to held Assets records; one contribution per mission per distinct kind, omitting zero groups.

E19.basis: Mapping 1.3 assigned assets joined to held Assets records; one contribution per mission per distinct status, omitting zero groups.

E20.basis: Mapping 1.3 assigned assets targeting AST-0004; each mission once; exact Decimal sum of non-null estimatedCostCredits.

E21.basis: Personnel COMMAND members joined through mapping 1.3 to commandingOfficerId; omit zero mission counts.

E22.basis: PRS-2018 via mapping 1.3 in commander/assigned crew union, one count per mission, grouped by mission status.

E23.basis: All ten Personnel pages (1000 unique IDs) minus mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew targets across all 300 missions; civilian records grouped as CIVILIAN.

E24.basis: Every Personnel Section Supervisor; count distinct missions whose mapping 1.3 commander/assigned union includes that ID, including zeros.

E25.basis: Mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew joined to Personnel; one mission contribution per department, civilian records grouped as CIVILIAN.

E26.basis: EXPLORATION missions; union of mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew targets held in Personnel and separate union of assigned asset targets held in Assets. People deduplicated across all selected missions before counting.

E27.basis: FIRST_CONTACT missions; union of mapping 1.3 commander/assigned crew targets held in Personnel and separate union of assigned asset targets held in Assets. People deduplicated across all selected missions before counting.
